title: Type-preserving deserializer used (csharp)
description: csharp code deserializes with a formatter that records CLR types in the stream (new NetDataContractSerializer(payload)). The payload chooses which type is constructed, and a gadget chain in any loaded assembly then runs during deserialization. This lexical rule flags the formatter; the reviewer replaces it with a data-only format.
remediation: Use a data-only serializer such as System.Text.Json with explicit types, or System.Text.Json with explicit types, for anything that crosses a trust boundary.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the formatter regardless of where the bytes came from.
